newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB shares rises despite cut in rating.
newsitem.headline: NCB shares rises despite cut in rating.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd shares rose in Friday afternoon trade, undaunted by a cut in the rating for its bonds by Moody's Investors Service, brokers said.
As of 0504 GMT, the shares were up 15 yen at 295 yen with trade totalling 7.085 million shares. It was the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
"There is a great technical need to buy back the shares and the market is turning a blind eye to the news," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
Moody's said on Friday it had cut its rating for Nippon Credit Bank Ltd bonds to Ba1 from Baa3.

Brokers said apart from technical grounds, with the end of the fiscal year nearing, market participants were buying back banking sector 0#BNK.T shares in order to prop up indices and brighten market sentiment.
